title: Sobriety is local on an open covering with noetherian intersections
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that sobriety of a topological space is local on an open covering whose members have noetherian pairwise intersections (author lemma at source lines 1248-1259, label lemma-sober-local). The proof (source lines 1261-1289) produces generic points inside a member of the cover and controls them across intersections using the noetherianity hypothesis, and proves uniqueness by restricting to the members (proof lines 1261-1288). The localisation argument is the content. H3.
